title: Tunisian Christmas Crumble Pudding
description: A unique and delicious dessert combining the flavors of Tunisia with traditional Christmas pudding, topped with a crunchy crumble.

ingredients.name: herbal tea
ingredients.notes: cooled and used as a substitute for milk

instructions: Prepare the dates by soaking them in water overnight and draining.
Mix the almond flour, crunchy granola, tunisian spice mix, and vanilla extract in a bowl.
Add the herbal tea to the mixture and stir well.
Add the christmas pudding mix to the mixture and stir until well combined.
Transfer the mixture to a baking dish and top with the crumble topping.
Bake for 40-45 minutes or until the top is golden brown.
